description: Na₆MgV₂O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ square pyramid, corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.54 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.45 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.52 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.52 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MgO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one VO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.89 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ square pyramid, corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.89 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form ONa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with four ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent ONa₃V trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃V trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃V trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom to form distorted ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgV trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom.
